description: Known identifiers used for SQL generation context. Current analytical views are primarily node/time scoped.

known_runs.source: README sample query and dashboard generation examples
known_runs.note: Current live KPI views do not expose run_id columns, so this ID may be ignored by view-only SQL.

refresh_queries.runs: SELECT run_id, scenario, ingested_at FROM runs ORDER BY ingested_at DESC;
refresh_queries.nodes: SELECT DISTINCT node_id FROM v_voltage_violations ORDER BY node_id;
refresh_queries.devices: SELECT DISTINCT node_id AS device_id FROM v_soc_summary ORDER BY node_id;
refresh_queries.view_columns: SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('v_voltage_violations','v_soc_summary','v_dr_power_summary','v_voltage_control_summary','v_kpi_run_summary') ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position;
